caption: The drawing depicts a single, transparent, glass bowl with a wide, flaring rim and a rounded body that tapers slightly inward toward the base. The glass is colorless with subtle greenish-blue tints and highlights, suggesting its reflective and transparent nature. The bowl is centered on a plain beige background, and there are no other objects present in the composition. The base of the bowl features some detailing indicative of glasswork, and the overall shading and reflections indicate the thickness and clarity of the glass. The drawing includes the name "John Dana" written below the bowl on the background, and there is a small scale to the lower left of the image.
title: Milk Bowl
